newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real closes steady on dollar inflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real closes steady on dollar inflows.

text.p: Brazil's real closed steady at 1.0296 to the dollar on the commercial foreign exchange market on dollar inflows, dealers said.
As on Monday, the real traded earlier at 1.0300 per dollar on bank speculation over a possible new drop in the real-dollar mini-band, currently at between 1.0295 and 1.0345 per dollar.
But the Central Bank again disappointed the market and left the mini-band unchanged, which caused banks to sell dollars.
Dealers said the market still expects a drop in the mini-band in coming days.
The local currency recovered during the day also due to dollar inflows. Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Tuesday surplus of around $165 million.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0352 to the dollar, down 0.01 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real fell 0.28 percent to close at 1.093 per greenback.
